scope:
Full-BDA MIPS CPU-renderer workload, not physical display/FPS timing.

Initial Game comes from a read-only physical snapshot. Modeled read-only FS
and heap serve the original assets. Normal ticks warm animation/history/cache
state before measurements. No game outcomes, pixels or visibility are patched.
limit: Instruction slots and modeled file bytes only. No physical cache/bus/div latency, display/MXU/audio/interrupt/scheduling timing or FPS. Platform history starts new; normal warm ticks advance the captured Game, so this is a workload from a real initial state, not an exact physical frame replay.
